column3: Close to the Hebrew; “who will give you” is rendered “Oh, that you were.”
Close to the Hebrew; “she will teach me” is rendered “She who used to instruct me.”
NKJV adds the heading “(TO THE DAUGHTERS OF JERUSALEM).”
The Hebrew “why will you awaken” is rendered as a prohibition, “Do not stir up nor awaken love.”
NKJV adds the heading “RELATIVE”; “was in labor with you” is rendered “brought you forth.”
NKJV adds a heading; “Sheol” is rendered “the grave,” “severe” “cruel,” and “a flame of Yah” “A most vehement flame.”
NKJV adds the heading “THE SHULAMITE’S BROTHERS.”
Close to the Hebrew; “shut up over her” is rendered “enclose her.”
NKJV adds a heading; “peace” (shalom) may pun on “Shulamite.”
Close to the Hebrew; “gave” is rendered “leased,” and NKJV supplies “coins.”
NKJV adds the heading “THE SHULAMITE”; “flee” is rendered “Make haste.”
